About the club

About Atlas Weightlifting.

Atlas Weightlifting is a community-driven club dedicated to developing athletes at every stage — from young lifters taking their first steps in the sport, through adult competitors, and all the way to experienced masters athletes. Although we support lifters of all ages, our core focus is on delivering outstanding youth development pathways that build strength, confidence and long-term athletic potential.

Our history

From 1953 to today.

Atlas Weightlifting was founded in 1953 in the East Midlands, beginning as a small, volunteer-run club in the heart of the local community. In its early years, lifters trained with limited equipment but limitless enthusiasm, reflecting the traditional British weightlifting culture of the time. The club quickly became known for its welcoming atmosphere, strong technical foundations, and a commitment to helping lifters improve regardless of age or experience. As it grew, Atlas expanded across the region and made its home in Nottingham.

As the sport evolved through the 1960s, 70s and 80s, Atlas expanded its coaching team, modernised its facilities and embraced new training methods. A major milestone came in 2018 with the launch of Atlas Junior Weightlifting, led by coach Nigel, which formalised the club's commitment to nurturing young lifters — introducing structured youth pathways, fun and engaging sessions, and a friendly, supportive environment designed to help children and teenagers fall in love with the sport. Over time, these developments transformed Atlas from a modest grassroots club into a respected talent academy, celebrated for producing technically skilled, confident young athletes, while still providing high-quality coaching for adults and masters.

Founder Cyril Martin & his coaching book
Our coaching philosophy

Precision, patience, strong foundations.

Atlas has been shaped by many dedicated coaches over the decades. The clear technical principles and long-term development approach in Cyril Martin's work helped influence our coaching style — especially the emphasis on precision, patience and strong foundational movement. Those ideas sit alongside modern sport-science practice and the expertise of our wider coaching team, creating a balanced, progressive environment for every athlete.

Adults & Masters

Barbell to platform.

You don't need to be strong, fit or experienced to start — just turn up. Coaches teach the lifts from the ground up, at your pace, whether you're here to feel better, get strong, or compete. Masters athletes are just as welcome as first-timers.

Atlas Juniors · Ages 8–18

Developing the young lifter.

Youth development is the heart of the club — and it's meant to be fun. Our junior sessions are friendly, supportive and full of energy, the kind of place a young person looks forward to. Coached well, weightlifting is also one of the safest and most rewarding things they can do — building strength, coordination, discipline and real confidence, with a clear pathway from first lift to the competition platform.

01

Beginner

Movement, body awareness and the basics of the lifts — learning to train safely and enjoy it.

02

Improver

Refining technique, building strength progressively and developing the habits of a real lifter.

03

Advanced

The competition pathway — for young lifters ready to test themselves on the platform.

The coaching team

Coached by people who know the sport.

Our coaching team brings decades of combined experience across youth, adult and masters lifting — technically sharp, patient, and genuinely invested in every athlete's progress.

N
Coach

Nigel

Has coached young people across three sports since 2001, and launched Atlas Junior Weightlifting in 2018.

Coaching youth since 2001
R
Coach

Rachel

A high-performance gymnastics coach from 1997, Rachel moved into Olympic weightlifting as a Masters athlete — qualifying as a weightlifting coach in 2023 and taking European Masters silver in 2025. She's also a qualified strength & conditioning coach and yoga instructor, and loves helping lifters of all ages and abilities reach their potential.

Coaching since 1997
L
Coach

Lance

A PE teacher who moved into long-term athletic development, Lance co-founded the Nottingham Athletic Development Academy, supporting over 100 young people across sports to reach their potential and stay injury-free. He found weightlifting at Atlas around 2019 — coached by Nigel, with advice from Cyril — and won Masters silver at the 2023 British Championships in Glasgow. He also helped start the club's junior section, and brings big ideas and relentless energy to everything he does.

Developing youngsters since 2006
C
Founder · Est. 1953

Cyril Martin

Founded the club in 1953 and remains part of its story. His writing on long-term athlete development still shapes how Atlas coaches today.
